Complete scalar congruence lattice using a gcd quotient, including all-zero labels.
Unimodular LLL transform verification and exact rectangular Bareiss GS/Babai.
Work-charged single rounding-deviation lists and public center perturbations.

conditional_reductions.exact_CVP_to_pair: At most2M+1 pointwise single-witness oracle calls, with exact terminal digit checks.
conditional_reductions.approximate_CVP_to_one_witness: Squared approximation factor strictly below1+3/M when a native word exists.
conditional_reductions.native_pair_to_weak_quantum_learner: Population informative acceptance4*beta at the actual underfull original-source scale.

proof_obligations_before_candidate_accep.PO-REVIEW: Independent review of exact geometry, gcd completeness and conditional reductions.
proof_obligations_before_candidate_accep.PO-COVERAGE: Inverse-polynomial TWO-witness coverage under IID stripped labels and independent uniform targets, not planted or success-only data.
proof_obligations_before_candidate_accep.PO-COST: Polynomial charged preparation/decoding with capped or occupancy-weighted source runtime; no hidden exponential list.
proof_obligations_before_candidate_accep.PO-SLICES: Prove pointwise solver guarantees or a valid distributional reduction for adaptive coordinate slices.
proof_obligations_before_candidate_accep.PO-ACCESS: All pair selection uses ONLY stripped source labels, target and public randomness.
proof_obligations_before_candidate_accep.PO-BASELINE: Compare actual unknown-secret quantum access to legal classical access, not known phase substitution.
proof_obligations_before_candidate_accep.PO-VECTOR-REDUCTION: No extension from scalar gcd arithmetic to vector-secret lattice/HSP instances without a new reduction.
proof_obligations_before_candidate_accep.PO-HARDWARE-AMPLIFICATION: Retain the physical receiver and full-secret bootstrap obligations; no free source copies or ideal inverse oracle.

falsifiers: Illegal one-hot encoding, shell norm mismatch, wrong congruence or non-unimodular lattice change.
Duplicate or singleton outputs counted as two witnesses.
Fixed-quota scaling hides untested bases, deflation costs or empty targets.
Empirical pair fractions are treated as population or pointwise guarantees.
Heuristic failure is treated as a classical hardness certificate.
